lyrics:
Verse 1:
Hey there, have you noticed how smart your Mac has become?
It's got a feature called Localized AI that's second to none!
Your device can understand the context of what you write
And offer suggestions just when they're needed, day or night!

Chorus:
Localized AI on your Mac, making life so easy
Personalization is the key! (Ah ah)
With local knowledge working its magic from within,
Privacy concerns are now far behind!

Verse 2:
Imagine typing away at home, in a cozy, warm space
Your Mac learns your style and offers suggestions based on every page
Whether it's drafting an email or planning your day
Localized AI helps you work smarter, not harder, in any way!

(Repeat Chorus)

Bridge:
When you're brainstorming late into the night,
Your Mac knows just what to write.
From cooking up a storm in the kitchen to sorting through photos with ease,
Localized AI makes every task feel like a breeze!

(Repeat Chorus)

Outro:
Localized AI on your Mac, making things more intuitive
Personalization is now our foundation! (Ah ah)
With local knowledge guiding the way, data stays secure and tight,
Embrace this future of computing, and productivity will shine so bright!
